objective: Flagship month: win on excitement and economics. Two products that exist only in April (the 9-Month Lease and the 9-Class Pack), a 9:09 flash, a wheel you can double, numbered Club Nine annuals and a month of events, with no offer above 25% effective (cash ≤20% except annuals, the flash and the bulk pack). Every April buyer leaves with a reason to come back in May.
strategy:
Cloud Nine — 9 Years of Physique 57.

Commercial job: Flagship month: win on excitement and economics. Two products that exist only in April (the 9-Month Lease and the 9-Class Pack), a 9:09 flash, a wheel you can double, numbered Club Nine annuals and a month of events, with no offer above 25% effective (cash ≤20% except annuals, the flash and the bulk pack). Every April buyer leaves with a reason to come back in May.

Upgrade: Moving In Together (The 9-Month Lease) (“Nine years in, we’re ready to move in together. 99 keys. No second batch.”). A numbered, one-month-only product gives people a reason to buy now without cutting the price of the core memberships. April 2026 was bought with 40–48% codes; scarcity sells the long plan at 17.5–20% instead.

Renewal: Club Nine: The Founders’ Table (“Nine numbered seats per studio. Founder perks for a year.”). Annual buyers are the most valuable members in the book; a numbered seat with doubled perks costs less than a deeper price and gives them something to show off.

Renewal: Spin Class (Literally) (“Renew, then spin. Every spin wins. Feeling brave? Double it.”). Clients who use 75%+ of their sessions renew at 80–86%. The doubling option pays the prize only when the member books the classes that make them renew again; the expected value of a spin is ≈₹1,900 Mumbai / ₹1,350 Bengaluru.

Newcomer: Party Crasher Pass (“It’s our 9th birthday and you’re invited. 3 classes for ₹999.”). A booked sequence of classes is what converts; the party class gives newcomers the best room of the year, and the buzzer turns a sale into a show for whoever is waiting.

Lapsed: Faking Your Own Death Didn’t Work (“We wrote your obituary. You’re not getting out of it that easily.”). Lapsed clients already know the product; what they need is a moment and a reason that is not just a discount. A personal postcard with a dated class beats a generic reminder.

Referral: Plus One, Plus Nine (“Bring a friend, get 9 days. Bring three, get a month.”). Referrals convert at 22–76% against 3.8–5.7% for website leads. A tier at three friends gives the super-connectors a reason to keep going.

Spot: The 9:09 Panic Attack (“Plank for your price. Or wait for 9:09 and panic with everyone else.”). A price you earn with your body is the most Physique 57 thing there is, and every plank at the desk is a show for whoever is waiting. The floor price (23.7% / 24.0%) sits inside the 25% spot cap, and plan revenue is counted at the floor.

Upgrade: The Cloud Nine 90 (“Ninety classes. One year. Zero commitment issues.”). The Anniversary Big 85 Flex sold 4 times at Kemps Corner and once at Kenkere House in April 2026; this replaces it at a price inside the bulk cap.
notes: Build: 129 new buyers × ₹11,150 first-60-day spend = ₹14.4L; 141 renewals × ₹23,384 = ₹33.0L; 63 winbacks = ₹7.2L; privates/retail/drop-ins ₹5.4L. Offers carry ₹45.1L (75% of target); the rest is business-as-usual. Funnel uses measured rates (lead→trial 51% CRM status, trial→member 26.9%) — not invented lifts.

pieces.detail: Mumbai: 3 classes in 9 days for ₹999, any format, including a Birthday Bash party class (17–18 Apr). Kenkere: 3 Barre classes for ₹699 (replaces the 50% intro in April; counts as the once-in-a-lifetime 2-for-1). Pop-ups: 2 classes for ₹999. The pass price is credited against a first 1 Month or 12-class pack bought within 72 hours of class 3, on top of the standard 15% (1 Month nets ₹16,204 / ₹11,707). Buy within 9 hours of class 3 and you hit the Impulse Buzzer: confetti, applause, name on the Reckless Decisions board.

pieces.headline: We wrote your obituary. You’re not getting out of it that easily.
pieces.copy: We wrote your obituary. It was moving. Unfortunately for you, you’re invited back: 15% off, a bonus for every year you’ve been with us, and a candle-lit Séance Class to rise from the dead.
pieces.detail: Lapsed 61 days–3 years get an obituary postcard (“Here lies a perfectly good plank”). It is the ticket to the candle-lit Séance Class on Thu 15 Apr. Come back on the standard 15% on 1 Month, a 12-class pack or 3 Months, plus a bonus for every year since your first class (max 3): +1 class on packs, +1 day on unlimited. Photo at the Back From the Dead frame; your row at the Throwback Reunion (Sat 24 Apr).

pieces.headline: Bring a friend, get 9 days. Bring three, get a month.
pieces.copy: Bring a friend to the party: if they join, you get 9 extra days. Bring three and the next month is on us. They get 15% off and a Cloud Nine tote.
pieces.detail: Any active member whose never-been friend buys in April gets +9 days (pack members: +2 classes). Three buying friends = a free month. The friend gets the standard 15% and a Cloud Nine tote. Bring Your Barre-stie day (Thu 8 Apr): every member gets a free guest pass.

pieces.headline: Plank for your price. Or wait for 9:09 and panic with everyone else.
pieces.copy: Plank for your price: hold it for 57 seconds and the 9-Class Pack is ₹12,999; hold for 2:57 and it’s ₹11,499. Or wait for 9:09 on 9 April, when everyone gets the floor price for 99 minutes. Panic responsibly.
pieces.detail: The Limited Edition 9-Class Pack (99 days to use it) exists only in April. Plank Your Price at the desk: hold 57 seconds and it is ₹12,999 (Kenkere ₹8,699), 1:57 for ₹12,249 (₹8,199), 2:57 for the floor, ₹11,499 (₹7,699). On Fri 9 Apr, two 99-minute windows from 9:09 am and 9:09 pm give everyone the floor price, no plank needed: siren in studio, countdown on Instagram. Pop-ups: a 9-class pack at ₹6,499 in the same windows.

pieces.headline: Ninety classes. One year. Zero commitment issues.
pieces.copy: Ninety classes, one year, zero commitment issues: the Cloud Nine 90 works out to ₹1,500 a class. April only.
pieces.detail: 90 classes valid for 12 months: Mumbai ₹1,34,999 (₹1,500 a class; 90 singles cost ₹1,74,825 at list, so 22.8% off), Bengaluru ₹99,999 (₹1,111 a class against ₹1,27,575, 21.6% off). April only, any format.

crm.rule: One send per offer to its own audience; no member gets more than 2 offer sends a week.

sends.audience: Members ready for a long commitment and returning clients who want the best price of the year.
sends.message: Nine years in, we’re ready to move in together. The 9-Month Lease: 9 months unlimited, 9 freezes, the anniversary hoodie and a numbered brass key. 99 keys in Mumbai, 39 in Bengaluru. When they’re gone, they’re gone.

sends.audience: Members on 3-Month or longer plans; annual renewers.
sends.message: Nine seats. Nine years. Club Nine is an annual membership with the perks doubled: 4 privates, 8 guest passes, priority booking all year and a numbered jacket. Nine per studio, and then the table is full.

sends.audience: Members renewing 1 Month or a 12-class pack.
sends.message: Renew in April and spin the Wheel of Nine: every spin wins. Then decide: keep your prize, double it, or gift it to a friend. Odds are on the wall, because we’re not that kind of casino.

standardTrade.note: Full-price trade: memberships, packs and privates sold at list with no offer behind them. Owned by the studio manager and the front desk, not by a campaign. The plan does not model it offer by offer.
